description: Cutting rations for those who could not contribute. The hollow eyes of the hungry follow {name} through every corridor.
title: The Ration Cut

description: Reducing food distribution below subsistence. {name} remembers every bowl they made smaller.
title: The Empty Bowls

description: Deliberately withholding food. The sound of hunger — a quiet, persistent thing — haunts {name}'s sleep.
title: The Starvation Order

description: Leaving a companion behind during an expedition. {name} still checks over their shoulder, expecting to see the face they abandoned.
title: The Abandoned

description: Abandoning someone who trusted {name}. Trust, once broken, leaves a scar on both sides.
title: The Betrayal of Trust

description: Turning away a stranger in need. {name} wonders if that person survived the night.
title: The Turned Back

description: Closing the hatch on desperate faces. {name} can still hear the knocking.
title: The Closed Hatch

description: Taking a life in cold judgment. {name} sees that face every time they close their eyes.
title: The Execution

description: Ending a life, even in necessity. {name} counts the names in the dark hours before dawn.
title: The Taking of Life

description: Pulling the trigger on another human being. The recoil leaves a bruise that never heals.
title: The Shot

description: Taking what wasn't offered. {name} hides the stolen goods and the shame in equal measure.
title: The Theft

description: Keeping more than a fair share while others go without. The excess weighs heavier than hunger.
title: The Hoard

description: Stripping a cache bare, leaving nothing for those who might follow. {name} knows they condemned someone.
title: The Empty Cache

description: A lie told to protect oneself at another's expense. The truth surfaces in {name}'s dreams.
title: The Lie

description: A deception that shifted burden onto the innocent. {name} avoids the eyes of those they deceived.
title: The Deception

description: A betrayal of someone who called {name} friend. The word 'friend' has tasted like ash ever since.
title: The Betrayal

description: Harsh words spoken in a moment of weakness. {name} wishes they could take them back.
title: The Harsh Word

description: A refusal that cost someone dearly. {name} replays the conversation, looking for a different answer.
title: The Refusal

description: Denying someone what they needed. The denial was logical at the time — now it just feels cruel.
title: The Denial

description: Sacrificing another to save the many. The math is sound; the heart rejects it completely.
title: The Sacrifice of Another
